operations.name: doctor
operations.result: R: package, version. CLI: one line per check and a summary line; with --json, a document with schema, package, version (null when xemd does not load), summary (status and the count of each status) and checks (name, required, status, detail)
effects: CLI --install: install the unavailable R packages of Imports and jsonlite from CRAN into the first R library; with --source DIR, reinstall the xemd library from that checkout into the first R library, whether or not its version differs

operations.name: decompose
operations.result: RDS containing the list of decomposeTSL tables: signal, modes, residue or fitResidual, meanNoise, diagnostics, termination and the family tables; seed, with the seed of a method that draws noise

operations.name: compare
operations.result: RDS containing the decomposeTSL and measureModesTSL tables of every method, stacked with the column method first; seed, with the seeds of the methods that draw noise

operations.name: metrics
operations.result: RDS containing the tables of the input with metrics and metricsSeries; on the output of compare, computed method by method and stacked with the stacking keys first (method; after batch, source and then method)

operations.name: select
operations.result: RDS containing the tables of the input with modes reduced to the retained modes and selection; on the output of compare, computed method by method and stacked with the stacking keys first (method; after batch, source and then method)

operations.name: reconstruct
operations.result: RDS containing the tables of the input with reconstruction: the sum of the modes of each series and, with includeResidue, its residue or fitResidual; on the output of compare, computed method by method and stacked with the stacking keys first (method; after batch, source and then method)

operations.name: export
operations.result: one CSV file per table of the input RDS; with format wide, modes has one column per mode, NA where a series lacks the mode
effects: create CSV files in the output directory

operations.name: run
operations.result: one RDS file per step, with the result of its verb on the result of the previous step, and index.json
effects: create RDS files and index.json in the output directory

operations.name: batch
operations.result: one RDS file per step, with the tables of every input stacked with the column source first, and index.json
effects: create RDS files and index.json in the output directory

operations.name: calculate
operations.result: native result of the explicitly selected exported operation
